title: Independent finite-field verification of the Family 095 Hankel seed certificate
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; one separately tasked AI source/computational reviewer. Not human peer review.
claim: At the source-prescribed point and tangent over F7, the Hankel seed has rank 20 and its L restriction determinant 6; all ten weight blocks have product/bordered rank totals 136,84,302,623. All 24 displayed determinant values, 21 corner entries, six direct bordered minors and both signed-pivot examples agree. No discrepancy found in this finite ingredient.

verification.primary: Sorted index-tuples, sparse ordinary polynomial products and standard-library modular elimination.
verification.separate_ai_implementation: Exponent vectors from weak compositions and SymPy DomainMatrix over GF(7); no primary checker imports or copied arithmetic helper.
verification.shared_dependencies: Mathematical formulas, Python runtime and certificate JSON for expected minor/basis data. Reviewer separately transcribed weights, point, pivots and tangent. Coordinating session added canonical hash reporting only.
verification.reproduce: Install requirements-dev.txt; python reproduce.py from the pinned packet.
verification.expected_result: RESULT: modular Hankel seed, all displayed minors and ten rejecting runs independently reproduced

predecessors: OpenAI supplied the source construction, moment formula, bases, tangent and certificate data.
Pico original whole-family classification and independent-replay contribution process.
Classical finite-field linear algebra, polynomial multiplication, Schur complements and source-cited predecessors.
limitations: No characteristic-zero tangent lifting, simultaneous real-form argument, real PSD deformation or final no-lift proof checked.
The raw integer principal minor with determinant-1 is a boundary control, not a source counterexample. Printed specialization is not in the later real form.
No kernel verification, human peer review, global novelty or full theorem claim.
Advertised script absence established only within the completely inventoried pinned family subtree.

upstream_review.review_kind: Maintainer Pico AI replay and independently implemented finite-field cross-check; not human peer review or kernel verification.
upstream_review.independent_replay_scope: Pico rebuilt the finite calculation from the appendix text without reading the submitted checker implementations or certificate JSON, corroborating all ten weight ranks with a direct full bordered-matrix rank. E/Z entries were not separately rechecked.
